# Polyglot

> Polyglot turns pauses between Codex, Claude Code, Pi, and Hermes turns into
> private language-learning moments, with optional typed recall and local spaced
> repetition across 74 language directions.

## Use Polyglot

- [Source and installation](https://github.com/Amal-David/polyglot)
- [Project README](https://github.com/Amal-David/polyglot#readme)
- [Agent skill](https://polyglot-5os.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/polyglot/SKILL.md)

## Product boundaries

- The public website is documentation for locally installed software.
- Polyglot does not expose a hosted API, MCP server, A2A agent, authentication
  service, payment service, or commerce protocol.
- Typed answers are not retained; explicit grades schedule local review state.
